name: William Morris Gallery
description: The only public gallery devoted to the life and work of William Morris, housed in his childhood home in Lloyd Park. A genuinely world-class museum that happens to be free and in Walthamstow.
address: Lloyd Park, Forest Rd, Walthamstow, E17 4PP
tip: The gift shop is excellent for unique presents. Check the website for their temporary exhibitions - they're always interesting.
